newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to extinguish 70,000 government jobs.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to extinguish 70,000 government jobs.

text.p: Brazil will extinguish 70,000 federal government posts that are currently vacant, a spokesman for the Federal Administration Ministry said.
The government plans, in addition, to gradually phase out a further 20,000 posts once their current occupants leave them.
The measure does not represent a cut in federal payroll costs because the 70,000 posts have been unoccupied anyway and the additional 20,000 will probably involve pension payments.
"But, in the sense that these job postings won't be filled again, we are preventing an increase in future payroll expenditure," the spokesman said.
In all, the federal government has 140,000 posts unfilled at the moment. Many of those being extinguished are for masseurs, hairdressers and the like.
The ministry spokesman said no date had been set for the extinction of the 70,000 jobs but a decree was expected to be issued within the next few days.
